text: Call from Ines Halvorsen (MRN 88-40921), DOB 14/03/1958, about her follow-up after the knee replacement. Reports swelling worse in the evenings and pain waking her around 3am. Taking the co-codamol but says it upsets her stomach. Lives at 42 Elm Street, Ashcombe. Best number is 555-0142, or ines.halvorsen@example.com. Wants to know if she can drive yet. Advised to attend the review clinic Thursday.

Mother called on behalf of Tomas Reidy (MRN 88-41003), age 7. Rash on both forearms since Sunday, no fever, eating and drinking normally. Has used the emollient twice daily with no improvement. Contact number 555-0188. Household address 9 Cranmer Row. Asked whether the nursery needs a letter. Triage: routine appointment, no red flags reported.

Mr Devlin Okonkwo (MRN 88-39887), SSN 123-45-6789 on file for the insurance claim, called regarding his blood pressure readings. Home readings averaging 158/94 over the past week, was 142/88 at the last review. Currently on amlodipine 5mg. Reports no headaches or visual changes. Reachable on 555-0119 or at devlin.okonkwo@example.com. Requests medication review.

Ms Perrine Ashby (MRN 88-40550) called twice. Ongoing fatigue for six weeks, now with dizziness on standing. Recent bloods not yet discussed with her. Says she cannot get to the surgery as she has no transport from 17 Bellhouse Lane. Phone 555-0173. Flagged for a same-week telephone consultation with the duty GP.
